children: IT services company Infosys Ltd on Wednesday (September 16) said it has expanded its Indore Development Centre (DC) with the inauguration of a new 3,30,000 square feet Software Development Block (SDB-2) at its campus in the Super Corridor, Indore.

The expansion strengthens Infosys’ presence in Central India and its engagement with the region’s technology and talent ecosystem. Infosys Indore currently has more than 3,300 employees supporting global clients across Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI), Retail, Life Sciences and Manufacturing.

The expanded centre will strengthen the company's capabilities in cloud, application development, artificial intelligence and machine learning, and cybersecurity to address evolving client requirements. The expansion will also enable Infosys to tap into Central India's growing talent pool.

Infosys plans to deepen its engagement with Madhya Pradesh's academic and technology ecosystem through skilling programmes and institutional partnerships. The company said these engagements will include IIT Indore, IIM Indore and Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya (DAVV).
The inauguration ceremony was attended by Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav, Indore Member of Parliament Shankar Lalwani and Member of Legislative Assembly Manoj Nirbhay Singh Patel.

Infosys was represented by Chief Financial Officer Jayesh Sanghrajka, Executive Vice President Sunil Kumar Dhareshwar and Senior Vice President Niladri Prasad Mishra, along with other senior officials from the Madhya Pradesh government and Infosys.

The new building is aligned with Infosys' environmental, social and governance (ESG) commitments and high-performance green building standards. The centre includes low-energy cooling, smart building automation, rainwater harvesting and wastewater recycling. The facility will also have flexible workstations, training facilities and wellness centres.
Dr Mohan Yadav, Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh, said, "Indore is steadily emerging as an important technology hub, supported by a strong talent base and a growing innovation ecosystem.

Infosys' investment in Indore will create employment opportunities for the state’s skilled youth and further strengthen Madhya Pradesh’s technology ecosystem. We welcome Infosys’ renewed commitment to the state and look forward to its contribution towards technology-led and inclusive economic growth."
Jayesh Sanghrajka, Chief Financial Officer, Infosys, said, "We are delighted to expand our presence in Indore, reflecting our ongoing investment in talent, innovation, and digital capabilities.

The expansion will enable us to leverage the region’s strong talent pool, strengthen our capabilities across AI, cloud, and digital technologies, and deliver greater value to our global clients. It also reinforces our long-term commitment to Madhya Pradesh through continued investment and high-quality employment opportunities."
Shares of Infosys Ltd ended at ₹1,060.65, down by ₹15.35, or 1.43%, on the BSE.

title: Infosys expands Indore development centre with 3.3 lakh square feet software block
